subject.title: fix: antml:/mm: namespaced tool-call XML leaks into chat replies (#97750)

question: After the code blockers are fixed, should OpenClaw accept closed `antml:`/`mm:` attribute-dialect text promotion plus the additive Plugin SDK `preserveCodeRegions` option as the permanent repair/sanitizer contract?
